response.original_title: A Rua é Nossa! — Mulheres no Hip Hop
response.overview: The documentary “The Street is Ours! – Women in Hip Hop” comes from the realization that, in Foz do Iguaçu, the female presence in hip hop is still small and often invisible. In the rap battles that happen daily around the city, there are hardly any women on the mic. On the walls, few women sign their graffiti. Based on this reality, the film follows four women who work in different elements of hip hop: two MCs, a b-girl, and a graffiti artist. Each of them shares their perspectives and strategies for resistance within a culture that is mostly male-dominated.
response.title: A Rua é Nossa! — Mulheres no Hip Hop
